raw_affiliation: Stavroula is the launch Chief Editor of Nature Human Behaviour. Prior to joining the Nature Portfolio, she was the Editor of Trends in Cognitive Sciences, one of the leading reviews outlets in the behavioural sciences. Stavroula’s academic background is in linguistics, experimental psychology, and cognitive neuroscience.
